description: Package docs and source for coding agents, in one call: give an npm or PyPI package name (and optional version) and get its README as Markdown, description, license, repository, entry points and types, exports, dependencies and the full file list; pass file=<path> to read one source or type file (npm). From the npm registry, jsDelivr and PyPI. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

file.description: npm only: a path from files to read (src/index.ts, dist/index.d.ts)

name.description: Package name, optionally with @version (react, @types/node, requests, expo-widgets@58.0.29)

readme.description: false leaves out the README (default true)

name: package_docs

description.description: string, e.g. "TypeScript-first schema declaration and validation library

notes.description: string, e.g. "From the npm registry (the version's package.json) and jsDe

title: Package docs
